title: Catalyst sync prep - PM/Eng prep notes (Anya)
content:
Goal: efficient 30m sync to align PM priorities and unblock engineering lead. Keep it outcome-focused: decisions, owners, and due dates.

Agenda (30m)
- 0-3m: quick pulse - what keeps you up at night? (Ryo)
- 3-10m: API throttling rollout (staged traffic shaping) - decision point on default policy for free-tier vs paid customers
- 10-17m: Console telemetry and tracing rollout - opt-in vs forced, privacy/PII check for Private deploys
- 17-24m: Dedicated capacity sales asks - capacity forecast, SLA delta, fallback behavior for burst window
- 24-28m: Private deployments + KMS/HSM integration status and next steps
- 28-30m: quick recap + commit to action items

Prep notes / context
- API throttling: broken out to two tracks: (A) throttle control UI in Console (UX work), (B) backend default policy + token bucket implementation. Sales wants explicit per-customer default for dedicated customers.
- Recent anomaly: 2026-02-15 16:05 spike - median p95 latency for hosted text-gen increased from 180ms -> 420ms for 60s. Preliminary trace points to a cold-cache KV eviction pattern when sequence lengths change. Ticket created INF-2345.
- Console telemetry: new tracing hook (RFC #34) samples 5% globally. For Private customers with KMS, we need to ensure traces never contain plaintext prompts or keys - implement redaction at SDK boundary.
- Dedicated asks: Partner X wants guaranteed 50k TPM for Q2, willing to sign 12-month commit if we offer 99.9% latency SLO at 95th percentile. Need cost model + infra plan.

Decision points I want to land
- Default throttle policy for free-tier: (A) 5 r/s with soft burst to 10 r/s for 30s, or (B) 2 r/s strict. My leaning: A for better UX; but risk higher unit cost. Need Ryo's ops input.
- Console telemetry default sampling: keep 5% but add customer-level opt-out toggle. For Private, default to 0% unless explicitly enabled by admin.

Notes to ask Ryo
- How soon can we get a rollback window for the throttle policy? (SLA implications)
- Is the KV eviction regression fix small (hotfix) or requires runtime kernel tweak? ETA?
- Capacity planning: if Partner X signs commit, what GPU pool and autoscale policy do we need? Rough $ estimate for monthly run-rate?

Action items (owner - due)
- Ryo: assess risk of default throttle = A and confirm rollback plan; update INF-2345 with mitigation plan - due 2026-03-05
- Anya: Draft email to Sales with preliminary cost delta for Partner X commit (include per-GPU cost and estimated throughput) - due 2026-03-03
- Eden: Audit telemetry pipeline to add redaction at SDK boundary and create a minimal test matrix for Private customers - due 2026-03-10
- Samira: Design Console toggle for per-customer sampling and surface it in mock UI (Figma) - due 2026-03-08
- Ryo + Eng infra: quick spike to reproduce 2026-02-15 latency bump and attempt KV cache config change; short doc with findings - due 2026-03-04

Quick wins / things I can unblock from PM side
- I can prioritize the Figma for the throttle control UI this sprint - will drop other mock tasks.
- I can own comms draft for customers if we change default throttles; will coordinate with CX and legal for messaging.

Parking lot (non-urgent)
- Long-term: finer-grained billing signals for cost-aware routing (per-model token weight)
- Consider a "warm pool" for frequent short-sequence requests to reduce cold-KV costs
- Productize per-customer telemetry config in Private installs (admin console) - bigger project next quarter

Open questions / unknowns
- How much SRE headcount would we need to guarantee Partner X SLA? Is that hiring or reallocation? (cost impact)
- If we default telemetry to 0% for Private, how do we support debugging for air-gapped installs during incidents?

Meeting script (short)
- Start: quick pulse (1-2m)
- State decision on throttle (1-2m) and ask for Ryo's quick risk call (2-3m)
- Walk through KV regression hypothesis and ask for reproduction ETA (4-5m)
- Dedicated partner ask (3-4m) - align on what I should tell Sales today
- Close with KMS/telemetry ask and confirm owners (2-3m)

Follow-up email template (to send after meeting)
- subject: "Recap + action items - Catalyst sync (Anya/Ryo)"
- body: short bullet list of decisions, owners, due dates, and next check-in (I suggest next sync in 7 days)

Notes-to-self (private)
- Keep decisions reversible where possible. Avoid hard defaults that Sales will treat as permanent.
- Push for visibility: require ticket numbers in all infra asks so we can trace costs.

Last-minute thoughts
- If Ryo thinks default throttle A is too risky, propose feature flag rollout: enable A for 15% of new signups first, monitor cost delta for 2 weeks, then widen. That buys us time.

End.
